title: Cohomology on an open from a flasque associated-module resolution
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], W any open of Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and I any injective resolution of R as an R-module. For every n in N, Modules.H of the unit structure module on W in degree n is additively equivalent to the carrier of H^n(C_W(I)), with C_W the explicit sections complex [def-sbc-punctured-sections-complex]. No local-ring or puncture-complement hypothesis is required.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_open_h_addEquiv_injective_sections
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (I : InjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat.{u} R)) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (Modules.H (X := W.toScheme)
      (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) n ≃+
      ((puncturedSectionsComplex R W I.cocomplex).homology n).carrier)
